name: com.machinerylane/machinery-lane
title: Machinery Lane
description: Search vetted plastics equipment suppliers, review sources, and prepare RFQ comparisons.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search reviewed profiles and return matching products, official sources and canonical profile links. No results means only that the database has no match.

equipment.description: Optional equipment filter using a published representative product name or a reviewed alias.

limit.description: Results per page, from 1 to 20; defaults to 10.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Return a reviewed profile with representative equipment, buyer questions, sources and available credentials evidence at its original evidence level. Undisclosed information is marked unknown.

tools.name: prepare_rfq
tools.description: Compare selected profiles, their evidence and questions to confirm, with the existing RFQ worksheet and relevant guides. This does not calculate, rate suppliers, request quotes or send enquiries.

slugs.description: One to five supplier profile slugs.

equipment.description: Optional equipment name used to identify actual matches in each profile.

material.description: Optional material details you already know, kept as supplied.

throughput.description: Optional throughput details you already know, kept as supplied.

target.description: Optional required outcome or target you already know, kept as supplied.

operatingConditions.description: Optional operating conditions you already know, kept as supplied.
